6: // https://github.com/vmware-labs/verified-betrfs/tree/concurrency-experiments/concurrency/spsc-queue

8: // ANCHOR:full
9: use std::sync::Arc;
10: use vstd::atomic_ghost::*;

21: use verus_state_machines_macros::tokenized_state_machine;
22: 
23: // ANCHOR: enum_state
24: #[is_variant]
25: pub enum ProducerState {
26:     Idle(nat),  // local copy of tail
27:     Producing(nat),
28: }
29: 
30: #[is_variant]
31: pub enum ConsumerState {
32:     Idle(nat),  // local copy of head
33:     Consuming(nat),
34: }
35: // ANCHOR_END: enum_state
36: 
37: // ANCHOR: fields
38: tokenized_state_machine!{FifoQueue<T> {
39:     fields {
40:         // IDs of the cells used in the ring buffer.
41:         // These are fixed throughout the protocol.
42: 
43:         #[sharding(constant)]
44:         pub backing_cells: Seq<CellId>,
45: 
46:         // All the stored permissions
47: 
48:         #[sharding(storage_map)]
49:         pub storage: Map<nat, cell::PointsTo<T>>,
50: 
51:         // Represents the shared `head` field
52: 
53:         #[sharding(variable)]
54:         pub head: nat,
55: 
56:         // Represents the shared `tail` field
57: 
58:         #[sharding(variable)]
59:         pub tail: nat,
60: 
61:         // Represents the local state of the single-producer
62: 
63:         #[sharding(variable)]
64:         pub producer: ProducerState,
65: 
66:         // Represents the local state of the single-consumer
67: 
68:         #[sharding(variable)]
69:         pub consumer: ConsumerState,
70:     }
71:     // ANCHOR_END: fields
72: 
73:     pub open spec fn len(&self) -> nat {
74:         self.backing_cells.len()
75:     }
76: 
77:     // ANCHOR: inc_wrap
78:     pub open spec fn inc_wrap(i: nat, len: nat) -> nat {
79:         if i + 1 == len { 0 } else { i + 1 }
80:     }
81:     // ANCHOR_END: inc_wrap
82: 
83:     // Make sure the producer state and the consumer state aren't inconsistent.
84: 
85:     #[invariant]
86:     pub fn not_overlapping(&self) -> bool {
87:         match (self.producer, self.consumer) {
88:             (ProducerState::Producing(tail), ConsumerState::Idle(head)) => {
89:                 Self::inc_wrap(tail, self.len()) != head
90:             }
91:             (ProducerState::Producing(tail), ConsumerState::Consuming(head)) => {
92:                 head != tail
93:                 && Self::inc_wrap(tail, self.len()) != head
94:             }
95:             (ProducerState::Idle(tail), ConsumerState::Idle(head)) => {
96:                 true
97:             }
98:             (ProducerState::Idle(tail), ConsumerState::Consuming(head)) => {
99:                 head != tail
100:             }
101:         }
102:     }
103: 
104:     // `head` and `tail` are in-bounds
105:     // shared `head` and `tail` fields agree with the ProducerState and ConsumerState
106: 
107:     #[invariant]
108:     pub fn in_bounds(&self) -> bool {
109:         0 <= self.head && self.head < self.len() &&
110:         0 <= self.tail && self.tail < self.len()
111:         && match self.producer {
112:             ProducerState::Producing(tail) => {
113:                 self.tail == tail
114:             }
115:             ProducerState::Idle(tail) => {
116:                 self.tail == tail
117:             }
118:         }
119:         && match self.consumer {
120:             ConsumerState::Consuming(head) => {
121:                 self.head == head
122:             }
123:             ConsumerState::Idle(head) => {
124:                 self.head == head
125:             }
126:         }
127:     }
128: 
129:     // Indicates whether we expect the cell at index `i` to be full based on
130:     // the values of the `head` and `tail`.
131: 
132:     pub open spec fn in_active_range(&self, i: nat) -> bool {
133:         // Note that self.head = self.tail means empty range
134:         0 <= i && i < self.len() && (
135:             if self.head <= self.tail {
136:                 self.head <= i && i < self.tail
137:             } else {
138:                 i >= self.head || i < self.tail
139:             }
140:         )
141:     }
142: 
143:     // Indicates whether we expect a cell to be checked out or not,
144:     // based on the producer/consumer state.
145: 
146:     pub open spec fn is_checked_out(&self, i: nat) -> bool {
147:         self.producer == ProducerState::Producing(i)
148:         || self.consumer == ConsumerState::Consuming(i)
149:     }
150: 
151:     // Predicate to determine that the state at cell index `i`
152:     // is correct. For each index, there are three possibilities:
153:     //
154:     //  1. No cell permission is stored
155:     //  2. Permission is stored; permission indicates a full cell
156:     //  3. Permission is stored; permission indicates an empty cell
157:     //
158:     // Which of these 3 possibilities we should be in depends on the
159:     // producer/consumer/head/tail state.
160: 
161:     pub open spec fn valid_storage_at_idx(&self, i: nat) -> bool {
162:         if self.is_checked_out(i) {
163:             // No cell permission is stored
164:             !self.storage.dom().contains(i)
165:         } else {
166:             // Permission is stored
167:             self.storage.dom().contains(i)
168: 
169:             // Permission must be for the correct cell:
170:             && self.storage.index(i).id() == self.backing_cells.index(i as int)
171: 
172:             && if self.in_active_range(i) {
173:                 // The cell is full
174:                 self.storage.index(i).is_init()
175:             } else {
176:                 // The cell is empty
177:                 self.storage.index(i).is_uninit()
178:             }
179:         }
180:     }
181: 
182:     #[invariant]
183:     pub fn valid_storage_all(&self) -> bool {
184:         forall|i: nat| 0 <= i && i < self.len() ==>
185:             self.valid_storage_at_idx(i)
186:     }
187: 
188:     init!{
189:         initialize(backing_cells: Seq<CellId>, storage: Map<nat, cell::PointsTo<T>>) {
190:             // Upon initialization, the user needs to deposit _all_ the relevant
191:             // cell permissions to start with. Each permission should indicate
192:             // an empty cell.
193: 
194:             require(
195:                 (forall|i: nat| 0 <= i && i < backing_cells.len() ==>
196:                     #[trigger] storage.dom().contains(i)
197:                     && storage.index(i).id() == backing_cells.index(i as int)
198:                     && storage.index(i).is_uninit())
199:             );
200:             require(backing_cells.len() > 0);
201: 
202:             init backing_cells = backing_cells;
203:             init storage = storage;
204:             init head = 0;
205:             init tail = 0;
206:             init producer = ProducerState::Idle(0);
207:             init consumer = ConsumerState::Idle(0);
208:         }
209:     }
210: 
211:     // ANCHOR: transition_produce_start
212:     transition!{
213:         produce_start() {
214:             // In order to begin, we have to be in ProducerState::Idle.
215:             require(pre.producer.is_Idle());
216: 
217:             // We'll be comparing the producer's _local_ copy of the tail
218:             // with the _shared_ version of the head.
219:             let tail = pre.producer.get_Idle_0();
220:             let head = pre.head;
221: 
222:             assert(0 <= tail && tail < pre.backing_cells.len());
223: 
224:             // Compute the incremented tail, wrapping around if necessary.
225:             let next_tail = Self::inc_wrap(tail, pre.backing_cells.len());
226: 
227:             // We have to check that the buffer isn't full to proceed.
228:             require(next_tail != head);
229: 
230:             // Update the producer's local state to be in the `Producing` state.
231:             update producer = ProducerState::Producing(tail);
232: 
233:             // Withdraw ("check out") the permission stored at index `tail`.
234:             // This creates a proof obligation for the transition system to prove that
235:             // there is actually a permission stored at this index.
236:             withdraw storage -= [tail => let perm] by {
237:                 assert(pre.valid_storage_at_idx(tail));
238:             };
239: 
240:             // The transition needs to guarantee to the client that the
241:             // permission they are checking out:
242:             //  (i) is for the cell at index `tail` (the IDs match)
243:             //  (ii) the permission indicates that the cell is empty
244:             assert(
245:                 perm.id() == pre.backing_cells.index(tail as int)
246:                 && perm.is_uninit()
247:             ) by {
248:                 assert(!pre.in_active_range(tail));
249:                 assert(pre.valid_storage_at_idx(tail));
250:             };
251:         }
252:     }
253:     // ANCHOR_END: transition_produce_start
254: 
255:     // ANCHOR: transition_produce_end
256:     transition!{
257:         // This transition is parameterized by the value of the permission
258:         // being inserted. Since the permission is being deposited
259:         // (coming from "outside" the system) we can't compute it as a
260:         // function of the current state, unlike how we did it for the
261:         // `produce_start` transition).
262:         produce_end(perm: cell::PointsTo<T>) {
263:             // In order to complete the produce step,
264:             // we have to be in ProducerState::Producing.
265:             require(pre.producer.is_Producing());
266:             let tail = pre.producer.get_Producing_0();
267: 
268:             assert(0 <= tail && tail < pre.backing_cells.len());
269: 
270:             // Compute the incremented tail, wrapping around if necessary.
271:             let next_tail = Self::inc_wrap(tail, pre.backing_cells.len());
272: 
273:             // This time, we don't need to compare the `head` and `tail` - we already
274:             // check that, and anyway, we don't have access to the `head` field
275:             // for this transition. (This transition is supposed to occur while
276:             // modifying the `tail` field, so we can't do both.)
277: 
278:             // However, we _do_ need to check that the permission token being
279:             // checked in satisfies its requirements. It has to be associated
280:             // with the correct cell, and it has to be full.
281: 
282:             require(perm.id() == pre.backing_cells.index(tail as int)
283:               && perm.is_init());
284: 
285:             // Perform our updates. Update the tail to the computed value,
286:             // both the shared version and the producer's local copy.
287:             // Also, move back to the Idle state.
288:             update producer = ProducerState::Idle(next_tail);
289:             update tail = next_tail;
290: 
291:             // Check the permission back into the storage map.
292:             deposit storage += [tail => perm] by { assert(pre.valid_storage_at_idx(tail)); };
293:         }
294:     }
295:     // ANCHOR_END: transition_produce_end
296: 
297:     transition!{
298:         consume_start() {
299:             // In order to begin, we have to be in ConsumerState::Idle.
300:             require(pre.consumer.is_Idle());
301: 
302:             // We'll be comparing the consumer's _local_ copy of the head
303:             // with the _shared_ version of the tail.
304:             let head = pre.consumer.get_Idle_0();
305:             let tail = pre.tail;
306: 
307:             assert(0 <= head && head < pre.backing_cells.len());
308: 
309:             // We have to check that the buffer isn't empty to proceed.
310:             require(head != tail);
311: 
312:             // Update the consumer's local state to be in the `Consuming` state.
313:             update consumer = ConsumerState::Consuming(head);
314: 
315:             // Withdraw ("check out") the permission stored at index `tail`.
316: 
317:             birds_eye let perm = pre.storage.index(head);
318:             withdraw storage -= [head => perm] by {
319:                 assert(pre.valid_storage_at_idx(head));
320:             };
321: 
322:             assert(perm.id() == pre.backing_cells.index(head as int)) by {
323:                 assert(pre.valid_storage_at_idx(head));
324:             };
325:             assert(perm.is_init()) by {
326:                 assert(pre.in_active_range(head));
327:                 assert(pre.valid_storage_at_idx(head));
328:             };
329:         }
330:     }
331: 
332:     transition!{
333:         consume_end(perm: cell::PointsTo<T>) {
334:             require(pre.consumer.is_Consuming());
335:             let head = pre.consumer.get_Consuming_0();
336: 
337:             assert(0 <= head && head < pre.backing_cells.len());
338:             let next_head = Self::inc_wrap(head, pre.backing_cells.len());
339: 
340:             update consumer = ConsumerState::Idle(next_head);
341:             update head = next_head;
342: 
343:             require(perm.id() == pre.backing_cells.index(head as int)
344:               && perm.is_uninit());
345:             deposit storage += [head => perm] by { assert(pre.valid_storage_at_idx(head)); };
346:         }
347:     }
348: 
349:     #[inductive(initialize)]
350:     fn initialize_inductive(post: Self, backing_cells: Seq<CellId>, storage: Map<nat, cell::PointsTo<T>>) {
351:     }
352: 
353:     //// Invariant proofs
354: 
355:     #[inductive(produce_start)]
356:     fn produce_start_inductive(pre: Self, post: Self) {
357:     }
358: 
359:     #[inductive(produce_end)]
360:     fn produce_end_inductive(pre: Self, post: Self, perm: cell::PointsTo<T>) {
361:     }
362: 
363:     #[inductive(consume_start)]
364:     fn consume_start_inductive(pre: Self, post: Self) {
365:     }
366: 
367:     #[inductive(consume_end)]
368:     fn consume_end_inductive(pre: Self, post: Self, perm: cell::PointsTo<T>) {
369:     }
370: }}

372: // ANCHOR: impl_queue_struct
373: struct_with_invariants!{
374:     struct Queue<T> {
375:         buffer: Vec<PCell<T>>,
376:         head: AtomicU64<_, FifoQueue::head<T>, _>,
377:         tail: AtomicU64<_, FifoQueue::tail<T>, _>,
378: 
379:         instance: Tracked<FifoQueue::Instance<T>>,
380:     }
381: 
382:     pub closed spec fn wf(&self) -> bool {
383:         predicate {
384:             // The Cell IDs in the instance protocol match the cell IDs in the actual vector:
385:             &&& self.instance@.backing_cells().len() == self.buffer@.len()
386:             &&& forall|i: int| 0 <= i && i < self.buffer@.len() as int ==>
387:                 self.instance@.backing_cells().index(i) ==
388:                     self.buffer@.index(i).id()
389:         }
390: 
391:         invariant on head with (instance) is (v: u64, g: FifoQueue::head<T>) {
392:             &&& g.instance_id() == instance@.id()
393:             &&& g.value() == v as int
394:         }
395: 
396:         invariant on tail with (instance) is (v: u64, g: FifoQueue::tail<T>) {
397:             &&& g.instance_id() == instance@.id()
398:             &&& g.value() == v as int
399:         }
400:     }
401: }
402: // ANCHOR_END: impl_queue_struct
403: 
404: // ANCHOR: impl_producer_struct
405: pub struct Producer<T> {
406:     queue: Arc<Queue<T>>,
407:     tail: usize,
408:     producer: Tracked<FifoQueue::producer<T>>,
409: }
410: 
411: impl<T> Producer<T> {
412:     pub closed spec fn wf(&self) -> bool {
413:         (*self.queue).wf()
414:             && self.producer@.instance_id() == (*self.queue).instance@.id()
415:             && self.producer@.value() == ProducerState::Idle(self.tail as nat)
416:             && (self.tail as int) < (*self.queue).buffer@.len()
417:     }
418: }
419: // ANCHOR_END: impl_producer_struct
420: 
421: // ANCHOR: impl_consumer_struct
422: pub struct Consumer<T> {
423:     queue: Arc<Queue<T>>,
424:     head: usize,
425:     consumer: Tracked<FifoQueue::consumer<T>>,
426: }
427: 
428: impl<T> Consumer<T> {
429:     pub closed spec fn wf(&self) -> bool {
430:         (*self.queue).wf()
431:             && self.consumer@.instance_id() == (*self.queue).instance@.id()
432:             && self.consumer@.value() == ConsumerState::Idle(self.head as nat)
433:             && (self.head as int) < (*self.queue).buffer@.len()
434:     }
435: }
436: // ANCHOR_END: impl_consumer_struct
437: 
438: // ANCHOR: impl_new_queue
439: pub fn new_queue<T>(len: usize) -> (pc: (Producer<T>, Consumer<T>))
440:     requires
441:         len > 0,
442:     ensures
443:         pc.0.wf(),
444:         pc.1.wf(),
445: {
446:     // Initialize the vector to store the cells
447:     let mut backing_cells_vec = Vec::<PCell<T>>::new();
448:     // Initialize map for the permissions to the cells
449:     // (keyed by the indices into the vector)
450:     let tracked mut perms = Map::<nat, cell::PointsTo<T>>::tracked_empty();
451:     while backing_cells_vec.len() < len
452:         invariant
453:             forall|j: nat|
454:                 #![trigger( perms.dom().contains(j) )]
455:                 #![trigger( backing_cells_vec@.index(j as int) )]
456:                 #![trigger( perms.index(j) )]
457:                 0 <= j && j < backing_cells_vec.len() as int ==> perms.dom().contains(j)
458:                     && backing_cells_vec@.index(j as int).id() == perms.index(j).id()
459:                     && perms.index(j).is_uninit(),
460:     {
461:         let ghost i = backing_cells_vec.len();
462:         let (cell, cell_perm) = PCell::empty();
463:         backing_cells_vec.push(cell);
464:         proof {
465:             perms.tracked_insert(i as nat, cell_perm.get());
466:         }
467:         assert(perms.dom().contains(i as nat));
468:         assert(backing_cells_vec@.index(i as int).id() == perms.index(i as nat).id());
469:         assert(perms.index(i as nat).is_uninit());
470:     }
471:     // Vector for ids
472: 
473:     let ghost mut backing_cells_ids = Seq::<CellId>::new(
474:         backing_cells_vec@.len(),
475:         |i: int| backing_cells_vec@.index(i).id(),
476:     );
477:     // Initialize an instance of the FIFO queue
478:     let tracked (
479:         Tracked(instance),
480:         Tracked(head_token),
481:         Tracked(tail_token),
482:         Tracked(producer_token),
483:         Tracked(consumer_token),
484:     ) = FifoQueue::Instance::initialize(backing_cells_ids, perms, perms);
485:     // Initialize atomics
486:     let tracked_inst: Tracked<FifoQueue::Instance<T>> = Tracked(instance.clone());
487:     let head_atomic = AtomicU64::new(Ghost(tracked_inst), 0, Tracked(head_token));
488:     let tail_atomic = AtomicU64::new(Ghost(tracked_inst), 0, Tracked(tail_token));
489:     // Initialize the queue
490:     let queue = Queue::<T> {
491:         instance: Tracked(instance),
492:         head: head_atomic,
493:         tail: tail_atomic,
494:         buffer: backing_cells_vec,
495:     };
496:     // Share the queue between the producer and consumer
497:     let queue_arc = Arc::new(queue);
498:     let prod = Producer::<T> {
499:         queue: queue_arc.clone(),
500:         tail: 0,
501:         producer: Tracked(producer_token),
502:     };
503:     let cons = Consumer::<T> { queue: queue_arc, head: 0, consumer: Tracked(consumer_token) };
504:     (prod, cons)
505: }
506: // ANCHOR_END: impl_new_queue
507: 
508: // ANCHOR: impl_producer
509: impl<T> Producer<T> {
510:     fn enqueue(&mut self, t: T)
511:         requires
512:             old(self).wf(),
513:         ensures
514:             final(self).wf(),
515:     {
516:         // Loop: if the queue is full, then block until it is not.
517:         loop
518:             invariant
519:                 self.wf(),
520:         {
521:             let queue = &*self.queue;
522:             let len = queue.buffer.len();
523:             assert(0 <= self.tail && self.tail < len);
524:             // Calculate the index of the slot right after `tail`, wrapping around
525:             // if necessary. If the enqueue is successful, then we will be updating
526:             // the `tail` to this value.
527:             let next_tail = if self.tail + 1 == len {
528:                 0
529:             } else {
530:                 self.tail + 1
531:             };
532:             let tracked cell_perm: Option<cell::PointsTo<T>>;
533:             // Get the current `head` value from the shared atomic.
534:             let head =
535:                 atomic_with_ghost!(&queue.head => load();
536:                 returning head;
537:                 ghost head_token => {
538:                 }
539:             );
540:             // Here's where we "actually" do the `head != next_tail` check:
541:             if head != next_tail as u64 {
542:                 // Unwrap the cell_perm from the option.
543:                 let tracked mut cell_perm = match cell_perm {
544:                     Option::Some(cp) => cp,
545:                     Option::None => {
546:                         assert(false);
547:                         proof_from_false()
548:                     },
549:                 };
550:                 // Write the element t into the buffer, updating the cell
551:                 // from uninitialized to initialized (to the value t).
552:                 queue.buffer[self.tail].put(Tracked(&mut cell_perm), t);
553:                 // Store the updated tail to the shared `tail` atomic,
554:                 // while performing the `produce_end` transition.
555:                 atomic_with_ghost!(&queue.tail => store(next_tail as u64); ghost tail_token => {
556:                 });
557:                 self.tail = next_tail;
558:                 return ;
559:             }
560:         }
561:     }
562: }
563: // ANCHOR_END: impl_producer
564: 
565: // ANCHOR: impl_consumer
566: impl<T> Consumer<T> {
567:     fn dequeue(&mut self) -> (t: T)
568:         requires
569:             old(self).wf(),
570:         ensures
571:             final(self).wf(),
572:     {
573:         loop
574:             invariant
575:                 self.wf(),
576:         {
577:             let queue = &*self.queue;
578:             let len = queue.buffer.len();
579:             assert(0 <= self.head && self.head < len);
580:             let next_head = if self.head + 1 == len {
581:                 0
582:             } else {
583:                 self.head + 1
584:             };
585:             let tracked cell_perm: Option<cell::PointsTo<T>>;
586:             let tail =
587:                 atomic_with_ghost!(&queue.tail => load();
588:                 returning tail;
589:                 ghost tail_token => {
590:                 }
591:             );
592:             if self.head as u64 != tail {
593:                 let tracked mut cell_perm = match cell_perm {
594:                     Option::Some(cp) => cp,
595:                     Option::None => {
596:                         assert(false);
597:                         proof_from_false()
598:                     },
599:                 };
600:                 let t = queue.buffer[self.head].take(Tracked(&mut cell_perm));
601:                 atomic_with_ghost!(&queue.head => store(next_head as u64); ghost head_token => {
602:                 });
603:                 self.head = next_head;
604:                 return t;
605:             }
606:         }
607:     }
608: }
